headline: Stock Exchange: Milan Slips (-1%) with BTPs, Spread Rises to 111 - News - Ansa.it
summary: Piazza Affari deepened its losses after the first trades, with the FTSE MIB down 1%. Government bond sell-offs across Europe hit French, Italian and Greek debt hardest, and the Italian spread rose to 111.
why: The FTSE MIB is the benchmark index of Italy's largest listed companies, and the BTP-Bund spread measures the extra yield investors demand to hold Italian debt over German bonds.

impacts.name: FTSE MIB
impacts.why: The index fell about 1% after the first trades of the session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Sell-offs in European government bonds, with French, Italian and Greek debt under the most pressure, weighed on Italian stocks and widened the BTP spread.
